name: Statistics Midterm Study Group
summary: Review problem sets together before the midterm.
description: Bring your notes and the latest practice sheet. We’ll work through the toughest questions together.

name: Sunset Campus Run
summary: An easy 5K loop for every pace.
description: Meet by the North Gate. We’ll split into pace groups and finish with a stretch on the lawn.

name: Open Mic Night
summary: Music, poetry, comedy, and a friendly crowd.
description: Sign up at the door or come listen. All experience levels welcome.

name: Design Society Portfolio Swap
summary: Friendly peer feedback for works in progress.
description: Bring one project and one question. We’ll rotate in small groups for focused feedback.

name: Community Garden Morning
summary: Plant, weed, and meet people over coffee.
description: Tools are supplied. Wear shoes that can get muddy and bring a water bottle.

name: Rooftop Film Club
summary: A student-voted classic under the evening sky.
description: Tonight’s screening is Spirited Away. Blankets are welcome; chairs are provided.

name: Board Games & Pizza
summary: Drop in for quick games or stay all evening.
description: We have party games and strategy games. Feel free to bring a favorite.
